name: Q Technology (Group) Company Limited
summary: Q Technology (Group) Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the design, research and development, manufacturing, and sale of camera modules and biological recognition modules in the Mainland of China, Hong Kong, Vietnam, India, and internationally.
